info.title: NAE_Agent
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

alert_description.description: Provides a human readable detailed description of the alert description during the most recent execution.

alert_level.description: Status of the Policy Agent updated by the Script code: * `CRITICAL`: Script Agent has detected a critical   issue. * `MAJOR`: Script Agent has detected a major issue. * `MINOR`: Script Agent has detected a minor issue.

alert_level_updated_at.description: Timestamp, in epoch, of the last updated alert level. This field is updated when the alert level of policy agent is updated.

disabled.description: Disables the Agent, so it won't react to any alarms actions, etc.

encrypted_parameters_values.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Parameter](#/NAE_Parameter)
Particular agent values for the nae script parameters that are encrypted.

local_storage.description: Placeholder for all NAE Agent variables declared on the script. The map key will contain the variable name and the map value will contain the variable value.

nae_alerts_count.description: The total number of alerts issued by this NAE agent.

nae_baselines.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Baseline](#/NAE_Baseline)
Baselines created by the particular NAE Agent.

nae_graphs.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Graph](#/NAE_Graph)
Graphs related to the NAE Agent.

nae_monitors.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Monitor](#/NAE_Monitor)
Monitors created by the particular NAE Agent.

nae_rules.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Rule](#/NAE_Rule)
Rules created by the particular NAE Agent.

nae_rules_count.description: The total number of rules used by this NAE agent.

nae_script.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Agent](#/NAE_Agent)
NAE Script that corresponds to this agent.

nae_time_series_count.description: The total number of time series used by this NAE agent.

nae_watches.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Watch](#/NAE_Watch)
Watches created by the particular NAE Agent.

name.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Agent](#/NAE_Agent)
Name of a NAE Agent. This has to be a CNAME starting with NAE Script name followed by its own name (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor.agent1).

origin.description: Defines the origin of the agent. Set to `system` if the agent is inbuilt in the system. Set to `generated` if the agent is generated using user input. Set to `user` if the agent is uploaded by the user.

parameters_values.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Parameter](#/NAE_Parameter)
Particular agent values for the nae script parameters.

statistics.description: Statistics related to the ERROR state of policy agent. The applicable error states are: * `TIMEOUT`: Number of times, agent was stopped due to taking too much CPU time * `CALLBACK_NOT_FOUND`: Number of times the agent couldn't execute a callback, since function wasn't present in the code * `CPU_USAGE`: The percentage of CPU utilization of the agent * `INVALID_ACTION`: Number of times agent asked to perform an action that is not supported * `MEMORY_USAGE`: Amount of memory (in kbytes) used by the agent. * `RESOURCE_STARVATION`: Number of times, agent was stopped due to insufficient resources * `SYNTAX_ERROR`: Number of times agent failed due to syntax error.

alert_level.description: Status of the Policy Agent updated by the Script code: * `CRITICAL`: Script Agent has detected a critical   issue. * `MAJOR`: Script Agent has detected a major issue. * `MINOR`: Script Agent has detected a minor issue.

alert_level_updated_at.description: Timestamp, in epoch, of the last updated alert level. This field is updated when the alert level of poicy agent is updated.

error_at.description: Timestamp, in epoch, of the last error.

error_description.description: Provides a human readable detailed description of the error during the last execution.

executed_at.description: Timestamp, in epoch, when a Policy Agent was last executed. This differs from creation time, where the timestamp indicates the time a Policy Agent got created on the database.

last_activity_at.description: Last time an activity happened for this NAE Agent.

state.description: Current state of the Agent: * `SLEEPING`: Policy Agent is waiting for the events. * `EXECUTING`: Policy Agent is actively handling events.

parameters.name: NAE_Script.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [NAE_Script](#/NAE_Script)
Name of a NAE Script. This has to be a valid canonical name (CNAME) (i.e com.arubanetworks.bgp_monitor).

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

disabled.description: Disables the Agent, so it won't react to any alarms actions, etc.
